mechanism.rounding: all q4dot, serial block sums, BF16 conversion, BF16 weight product, final FP32 running sum/seed rounding edges and order unchanged

minimum_proof.vehicle: two adjacent heads at positions6/7, original vs fastpad
minimum_proof.boundary: new Q/key input at pos6 advanced42cycles; same external running-sum input dates; pos6 pad42, pos7 natural next-hop advancement49 and pad49
